name: btb-workout-log
description: Review, log, and edit your BTB Workout Log strength-training data from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
BTB Workout Log is a strength-training log app for iPhone. Connect it to ChatGPT to talk about your own training data: ask for a summary of last week, compare your bench press over time, or plan today's session based on what you actually did. You can also log workouts by describing them ("bench 60 kg x 10 for 3 sets yesterday") or paste records from another app to import them.

Imports can be undone in one step, and deletions are always reversible — the assistant cannot permanently delete anything. A BTB account is required; you sign in and approve access on our page, and you can disconnect at any time from the app.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my workouts from the last 7 days.
How has my bench press changed over the last 3 months?
Plan today's session based on my recent training.

positive.prompt: Summarize my workouts from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes each workout by date with exercises, weights and reps.

positive.description: Log a workout from natural language
positive.prompt: Log for yesterday: Bulgarian split squat 20 kg x 10, 3 sets.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports 3 sets for yesterday's date and reports the result with a batch_id.

positive.prompt: Undo the import you just made.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then reverts the import; the sets disappear from the app.

positive.prompt: Change the weight of the first squat set in my most recent leg day to 90 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent leg day, asks for confirmation if needed, and updates the first squat set to 90 kg.

positive.prompt: Delete my most recent leg day workout, then restore it.
positive.expected_behavior: Soft-deletes the workout, then restores it together with all its exercises and sets.

negative.description: General fitness knowledge: answer from general knowledge without calling BTB.
negative.prompt: What is good form for a bench press?

negative.description: Unrelated request: BTB should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: Meal data is out of scope: BTB does not handle nutrition data, so it should not be called.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read, log, import, edit, undo, soft-delete and restore workouts in BTB Workout Log.

ja-JP.subtitle: 筋トレ記録をChatGPTで
ja-JP.description:
BTB Workout Log は iPhone 向けの筋トレ記録アプリです。ChatGPT と接続すると、自分のトレーニングデータについて会話できます。先週の振り返り、ベンチプレスの推移比較、実際の記録に基づいた今日のメニュー作りなど。「昨日ベンチ60kg×10を3セット」のように話して記録したり、他アプリの記録を貼り付けて取り込むこともできます。

取り込みはワンステップで取り消せ、削除はいつでも元に戻せます（アシスタントが完全に削除することはできません）。BTB アカウントが必要です。当社のページでログインしてアクセスを許可し、アプリからいつでも連携を解除できます。
